findings.summary: The new NotificationJob invariant cancels a job that falls inside quiet hours, but the requirement says such reminders are deferred and the criterion says they are delivered when quiet hours end.
findings.evidence: entity.NotificationJob invariant: "A job whose delivery time falls inside the owner's quiet hours is cancelled at delivery" vs S.webapp.prompts: "A reminder that falls inside the owner's quiet hours must be deferred to the end of the quiet period" and C.webapp.prompts.bounded: "A reminder due during quiet hours is delivered when they end"

findings.summary: Deferring a reminder to the end of a quiet period that crosses midnight can move it into the next local day, and the spec does not say how this interacts with the one-notification-per-local-day limit.
findings.evidence: S.webapp.prompts: "limited to one owner notification per local day" ... "must be deferred to the end of the quiet period"; NotificationPreferences: "quiet hours, as a start and end time in the owner's time zone"
